# Budget 2026

## Emergency fund

Target: six months of essential expenses in a high-yield savings account.
Currently at four months; the gap closes by September at the current rate.

## Monthly categories

| Category | Share |
|---|---|
| Housing | 30% |
| Food | 12% |
| Transport | 8% |
| Savings and investing | 20% |
| Everything else | 30% |

## Investing

Low-cost index funds only, contributions on the first day of the month, no
attempt to time the market. Rebalance once a year.

## Subscriptions to cancel

The second streaming service and the unused gym membership.
